teacher_request.learning_goal: Understand force, motion and engineering design.

output.interpreted_goal: Explore how forces affect motion and use engineering design through testing, observation, and iteration.

choices.educational_reasoning: Designing and testing a track gives students a concrete way to observe how track features affect a moving marble. They can compare trials and reason about how to keep the marble on the track.
Changing the catapult setup and observing launches connects force to motion through comparisons. Students can make predictions about how design choices may affect the marble's movement.
Assembling and exploring a machine offers a way to investigate how different mechanisms affect work and motion, while prompting students to compare designs and explain their observations.
